stats.text:
The magic of your patron ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Warlock level specified in the Fiend Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

**Fiend Spells**

| Warlock Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/burning-hands}*, *{ref:spell/command}*, *{ref:spell/scorching-ray}*, *{ref:spell/suggestion}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/fireball}*, *{ref:spell/stinking-cloud}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/fire-shield}*, *{ref:spell/wall-of-fire}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/geas}*, *{ref:spell/insect-plague}* |
